description: Source code for FdkAacAudioDecoder class implementing AAC audio decoding using the FDK AAC library, including initialization, decoding, and stream management.

classes.name: FdkAacAudioDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles AAC audio decoding using the FDK AAC library, managing decoder state, input buffers, and output audio data.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: A class representing decoded AAC audio data, including sample data, timestamps, and audio sample info.

methods.name: FdkAacAudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AAC decoder.

methods.name: ~FdkAacAudioDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that tears down the AAC decoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callback functions.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder and schedules decoding.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and samples per second.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears buffers.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder and pushes EOS audio.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Opens and configures the AAC decoder.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the AAC decoder.

methods.name: WriteToFdkDecoder
methods.description: Feeds input buffer data into the decoder.

methods.name: ReadFromFdkDecoder
methods.description: Reads decoded frames from the decoder, handling flushing and output.

methods.name: TryToUpdateStreamInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and updates stream info such as channels and sample rate.

methods.name: TryToOutputDecodedAudio
methods.description: Processes and outputs decoded audio data, managing partial buffers and timestamps.
